subject: "No climate data for this site" Error

messages.author: d0a6c4e0144772a5
messages.subject: "No climate data for this site" Error
parts:
Dear all, 

I am attempting to extract data for lat long sites in Central America. All code runs and produces results, but I receive an error that states it is using dummy data and there is no environmental data for this site. The function still produces an output, but I am unsure if this error just corresponds to some of the variables that return "0" values, or if it has produced dummy data for all variables since this area is just not part of the micro_global set. My primary goal is to get TALOC values. 

Code: 

loc <- c(16.2, -90.9)
micro <- micro_global(loc = loc)

Error:
"Extracting climate data
no climate data for this site, using dummy data so solar is still produced
extracting soil moisture data
sorry, there is no environmental data for this location
running microclimate model for 12 days by 1 years at site"


Thank you very much in advance, and thank you for great tutorials and reading about this package. 

Sarah

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: "No climate data for this site" Error
parts:
Dear Sarah,

You'll get this if you are in the water so if you're doing sites near the coast you can have this happen because the climate layers are a bit blocky. But, in your case you've simply put the coordinates in the wrong way around.

Try
loc <- c(-90.9, 16.2) # longitude, latitude

All the best,
Mike
